user.title: Choose ABB Welcome device type
user.description: Choose **Web-admin IP gateway** for an ABB 83342/MRANGE gateway with a local web admin. Choose **App-managed Wi-Fi indoor station** for an M2240x/ASI22 device managed through MyBuildings/Welcome.

credentials.title: ABB Welcome credentials
credentials.description: Enter the credentials required for the selected {profile} profile. App-managed devices require the MyBuildings system ID as Gateway Portal UUID and are checked on SIP-TLS port 5061; no gateway admin password is used or stored.

data.gateway_uuid_override: Gateway Portal UUID / MyBuildings system ID

manual_authorize.title: Approve pairing on the gateway
manual_authorize.description:
Auto-approval failed, but the pairing request was sent successfully and is waiting on your gateway. Please finish the approval manually:

1. Open https://{gateway_ip}/ in a browser and log in as `admin`.
2. Navigate to the **Portal / Portal Client** page.
3. Find the pending app named:

    **{client_name}**

4. When prompted for an integrity code, enter:

    **{integrity_code}**

5. Confirm / Approve in the gateway UI.
6. Click **Submit** below to continue.

Home Assistant will wait up to 5 minutes for the gateway to confirm the pairing.

_Diagnostic detail: {error_detail}_

app_authorize.title: Waiting for automatic app pairing

pending_pairing.title: Recover unfinished pairing

discard_pending_pairing.title: Discard saved pairing?
discard_pending_pairing.description: This permanently forgets the saved Home Assistant key and certificate. The associated client cannot be recovered afterward. First remove or unpair that client from the official Welcome app/client management and MyBuildings, then click **Submit** to confirm.

pending_pairing_invalid.title: Saved pairing cannot be recovered
pending_pairing_invalid.description: The saved pending identity is unreadable or from an unsupported storage version. Its contents have not been logged. Remove the orphaned Home Assistant client from the official Welcome app/client management and MyBuildings, then click **Submit** to clear the unusable state and start again.

confirm.description:

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway web admin on HTTPS port 443. Check the IP address and that Home Assistant is on the same network.
error.sip_tls_unavailable: Cannot reach SIP-TLS port 5061 on the app-managed device. Check the IP address, device Wi-Fi, and network routing.
error.gateway_not_found: No IP gateway is visible to this portal account.
error.gateway_admin_auth_failed: Gateway admin password is wrong (login at https://gateway-ip/ as `admin` failed).
error.no_pending_app: The gateway did not see our pairing request. Try again or check that the portal account is linked to this gateway.
error.integrity_code_rejected: The gateway rejected the integrity code we computed. Open an issue with your gateway firmware version.
error.gateway_admin_failed: Talking to the gateway admin CGI failed — see the Home Assistant log.
error.gateway_op6_failed: Could not read the gateway's portal UUID. Some firmware versions have a broken portal-client endpoint. Fill in the optional 'Gateway Portal UUID' field and try again.
error.invalid_uuid: Gateway Portal UUID must look like 8d24f178-9c41-4aed-97e1-6008bb6aef82 (8-4-4-4-12 hex). Leave blank to auto-detect.
error.uuid_required: A valid Gateway Portal UUID / MyBuildings system ID is required for app-managed devices.
error.invalid_profile: Choose one of the supported device types.
error.acl_timeout_retry: No ACL update arrived yet. Wait for automatic app pairing or use Resend pairing request in the official Welcome app if offered, then submit again; the saved identity will be reused.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — see the Home Assistant log.

abort.acl_timeout: The gateway did not push a configuration after pairing. Try again.
abort.acl_parse_failed: The gateway sent a configuration but it could not be parsed. Check the Home Assistant log.
abort.pending_storage_failed: Home Assistant could not securely save or clear the pending pairing identity. No new pairing should be started; check the Home Assistant storage/log state.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error during ACL polling — see the Home Assistant log.

error.invalid_default_unlock_station: Select the door configured as the physical indoor panel default before enabling Hybrid.
